referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Partial Veto Referendum - QUESTION 1
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 1: “Partial veto. Shall section 10 (1) (c) of article V of the constitution be amended to prohibit the governor, in exercising his or her partial veto authority, from creating or increasing or authorizing the creation or increase of any tax or fee?”

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Freedom to Gather in Places of Worship During an Emergency Referendum - QUESTION 2
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 2: "Freedom to gather in places of worship during an emergency. Shall section 18 of article I of the constitution, which deals with religious liberty, be amended to prohibit the state or a political subdivision of the state from ordering the closure of, or forbidding gatherings in, places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including a public health emergency?"

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Governmental Entity Discrimination Prohibited Referendum - QUESTION 3
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 3: "Governmental entity discrimination prohibited. Shall section 27 of article I of the constitution be created to prohibit governmental entities in the state from discriminating against, or granting preferential treatment to, any individual or group on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin in public employment, public education, public contracting, or public administration?"

referendums.name: De Soto Area School District Educational Programs Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the De Soto Area School District, Vernon and Crawford Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $500,000 for the 2026-2027 school year, by $1,400,000 for the 2027-2028 school year and by $1,700,000 for the 2028-2029 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of maintaining facilities, instructional programs, student services and updating security and network technology systems?

referendums.name: Hillsboro School District Facilities and Programs Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the School District of Hillsboro, Vernon, Richland, Monroe, Juneau and Sauk Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,100,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes to maintain District facilities and current programs?

referendums.name: Viroqua Area School District Operating Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the Viroqua Area School District, Vernon and Crawford Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,800,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operation and maintenance expenses of the District?

referendums.name: Westby Area School District Education and Operating Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the Westby Area School District, Vernon, La Crosse and Monroe Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section I 21.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by$ I ,600,000 for the 2027-2028 school year, by $1,700,000 for the 2028-2029 school year, and by $1,800,000 for the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposes to sustain educational programs and to operate the District?
